quiz.q: How did Granville Austin counter the criticism that the Constituent Assembly was merely a one-party body?
options: By showing that Congress operated through consensus and actively co-opted leaders from other political parties.
By organizing an informal nationwide referendum that approved the draft constitution with an overwhelming popular majority.
By arguing that provincial elections of 1946 had already achieved universal adult suffrage across all Indian provinces.
By pointing out that judicial commissions continually reviewed and amended fundamental constitutional principles after independence.
quiz.why: Austin argued that Congress functioned by consensus and included diverse political opinions, making the Constitution widely representative.

quiz.q: During Constituent Assembly debates, what was the primary disagreement between Gandhians and modernists like Nehru and Ambedkar?
options: Gandhians demanded a fixed presidential executive, whereas modernists insisted on an accountable parliamentary cabinet system.
Gandhians championed decentralized Panchayati Raj, whereas modernists preferred a centralized system of representative democracy.
Gandhians wanted absolute fundamental property rights, whereas modernists argued for unrestricted socialist directive principles.
Gandhians supported peer appointment of judges, whereas modernists favored legislative supremacy over constitutional interpretation.
quiz.why: Gandhians favored decentralization through village panchayats, while Nehru and Ambedkar supported modern representative democratic institutions.

quiz.q: Why did the Supreme Court in Kesavananda Bharati rule that the Preamble can be amended by Parliament?
options: The US Supreme Court established binding doctrine holding that preambles override all substantive constitutional provisions.
The Gopalan ruling had already recognized the Preamble as an independent source of supreme legislative authority.
The Constituent Assembly adopted it last to ensure complete harmony with the main text, walking with the Constitution.
A special judicial commission had declared the Preamble separate from the amendable body of the basic document.
quiz.why: The Court recognized the Preamble was adopted last to walk with the Constitution, making it amendable alongside it.

quiz.q: Why did scholar C. Rajamohan compare Jawaharlal Nehru's subcontinental foreign policy to that of Lord Curzon?
options: Nehru dismantled all colonial security arrangements to promote regional integration through unconditional multilateral disarmament.
Nehru formed formal Cold War military alliances with Western powers to dominate South Asian maritime routes.
Nehru abandoned all historical border claims inherited from British treaties to avoid friction with adjacent states.
Nehru maintained the strategic approach of British India when managing security and relations with regional neighbours.
quiz.why: Rajamohan noted that Nehru's neighborhood diplomacy continued the strategic traditions established during the British Raj under Curzon.
